quantization.code_grid: e4m3fn, 4-bit exponent bias 7, 3-bit mantissa, subnormals below 2^-6
quantization.inject_rows: the layer's block_inject_weight rows are appended to the down table (rows 320..323) because the engine reads one [324, wide] GEMM; their error is reported separately

tool.layout: row-major e4m3 codes + one f32 scale an output row; the loader permutes the codes into qmmf's fragment order (zig/src/cuda/fp8.zig:packCodes) and the scales into its [npad/64][k/64][64] fp32 tile
tool.name: tools/dflash2/quantize/quantize_hc_fp8.py
